title: AMZN sitting at 249 after hitting ATH, worth selling 260 calls for Dec expiry?
summary: AMZN just made new highs at 254 couple days ago and now its chilling around 249. been looking at the Dec monthlies and the 260 calls are going for decent premiumI was checking out polymarket and theres like 74% odds that AMZN touches 260 before end of November, but only 15% chance it hits 276. basically everyone thinks it'll get to 260 but not much higherthinking of selling the 260 strike covered calls since I'm holding shares anyway. if it touches 260 I'm cool getting assigned there, thats still like 4% gain from current price plus I collect the premium. and if it just bounces around 250 like it has been I keep the premium and my sharesmy only worry is this thing has been on an absolute tear, up like 27% over the past year and AWS numbers were solid last earnings. what if this consolidation is just a pause before another leg up to 275+?the IV seems pretty normal for AMZN, not super elevated or anything. feels like one of those situations where the stock might be due for a breather but you never really know with mega capssubmitted by/u/TheSharpPosting[link][comments]

title: Australian wage growth steady in Q3, supports rate pause view
Judge orders temporary pause to contentious 340B rebate pilot
summary: Hospitals, in a lawsuit filed earlier this month, had called the controversial pilot's rollout a "textbook disregard of administrative law." A federal judge appears to agree, writing in a preliminary injunction order that the administration's "hastily assembled" pilot is likely a violation of the Administrative Procedure Act.

title: 86% Chance Trump Blinks on Tariffs, But Bitcoin Will Tell You First
summary: Tariffs set for Feb. 1 on Denmark, Norway, Sweden, France, Germany, the UK, the Netherlands and Finland over Greenland have jolted crypto. Bitcoin has fallen to about $92,000 after $875M liquidations, while traders watch for a pause, delay, exemption, or walkback in the first week as volume thinned.The post86% Chance Trump Blinks on Tariffs, But Bitcoin Will Tell You Firstappeared first onCryptonews.
